notes.title: Renewal of Leichang Town
notes.content:
3.2.1

1. Renewal of Leichang Town

2. Battle fluency optimization

3. The number of rewards for experience books decreases, and the effect of a single experience book increases

4. Automatic combat optimization (adjustable in settings)

5. Optimize the smoothness of equipment sold in stores

6. Add the "task tracker" on and off modes in the settings. If you encounter flashback on Android, you can turn it off and try again. Some mobile phones will be improved.
